name: Ross J. Maza
office: City of Alhambra, Member of the City Council, Second District

items.text: Ross J. Maza is the City of Alhambra council member for District 2 and was elected to that office in November 2022. He became vice mayor in August 2026. He served as Alhambra's mayor until June 2024. He has represented the city on the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments and the Independent Cities Association.
